definitions.explanation: Describes a warm, fond feeling toward something from the past. The subject evokes pleasant memories.

examples.english: Hearing this song makes me feel nostalgic.

examples.japanese: {懐|なつ}かしい⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met an old friend I hadn't seen in a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧！{懐|なつ}かしい⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Long time no see! It brings back memories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{懐|なつ}かしく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing the park where I played as a child made me feel nostalgic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていたら→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懐|なつ}かしい⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦よみがえって→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: While looking at old photos, many fond memories from my student days came flooding back.

notes:
{懐|なつ}かしい expresses a warm, fond feeling toward something from one's past: "nostalgic," "it brings back memories," "it's been so long."

USAGE:
The thing that brings back memories is the subject, marked with が:
- ⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{懐|なつ}かしい (I miss my hometown; my hometown fills me with nostalgia)
- The verb ⟦{懐|なつ}かしむ→懐かしむ：09913_natsukashimu⟧ takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ instead: ⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしむ→懐かしむ：09913_natsukashimu⟧ (to think fondly of one's hometown).

WATCH OUT:
{懐|なつ}かしい is about the past, not about someone you are apart from now. "I miss you" to a partner or family member is ⟦{会|あ}いたい→会う：00482_au⟧ or ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧, not {懐|なつ}かしい.

FORMS:
- {懐|なつ}かしく⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to feel nostalgic about)
- {懐|なつ}かしさ (nostalgia, noun)
- {懐|なつ}かし⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ (to show nostalgia, of someone else)
